items.title: US and rest of world must follow China’s lead on green energy, says John Kerry

sentences.en: US and rest of world must follow China’s lead on green energy, says John Kerry.
sentences.zh: 约翰·克里（ John Kerry ）表示，美国和世界其他国家必须效仿中国在绿色能源方面的领先地位。

sentences.en: Former US secretary of state says most nations are ‘stumbling along’ while Beijing has ‘hugely accelerated’ Cop31 live – latest updates China is leading the world in moving away from fossil fuels , and the rest of the globe – including the US – must now follow, the former US secretary of state John Kerry has told the Guardian, as Cop watchers wonder exactly how China is going to approach this year’s climate summit.
sentences.zh: 美国前国务卿约翰·克里（ John Kerry ）告诉《卫报》，大多数国家都“步履蹒跚” ，而北京方面则“大大加快了” COP31的实施速度--中国在摆脱化石燃料方面正在引领世界，包括美国在内的世界其他国家现在必须效仿，因为COP观察人士想知道中国将如何接近今年的气候峰会。

sentences.en: As Cop31 opens – this year the climate conference is in Turkey – there is plenty of speculation about whether China will finally step into the leadership role that it has long avoided.
sentences.zh: 随着第三十一届联合国气候变化大会（ COP31 ）的开幕--今年的气候大会将在土耳其举行--有很多人猜测中国是否会最终成为长期以来一直回避的领导角色。

sentences.en: In its latest “five-year plan” adopted in March 2026, China for the first time pledged to “actively participate in and lead global climate governance”.
sentences.zh: 在2026年3月通过的最新“五年规划”中，中国首次承诺“积极参与和领导全球气候治理”。

sentences.en: Cop31 could provide the first indications Beijing is ready to put that rhetoric into action, something it has historically been reluctant to do.
sentences.zh: Cop31可以提供北京准备将这种言论付诸行动的第一个迹象，这是它历史上一直不愿意做的事情。

items.title: Sudan war: First ‘suicide’ drone attacks, now long-range strikes are the norm

sentences.en: Sudan war: First ‘suicide’ drone attacks, now long-range strikes are the norm.
sentences.zh: 苏丹战争：第一次“自杀式”无人机袭击，现在远程袭击已成为常态。

sentences.en: Drones and drought are “closing in” on Sudan, the UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF), said on Tuesday, describing unprecedented attacks on the country’s infrastructure including by drones travelling up to 1,500 kilometres before hitting their target.
sentences.zh: 联合国儿童基金会（ UNICEF ）周二表示，无人机和干旱正在“逼近”苏丹，描述了对该国基础设施的前所未有的袭击，包括无人机在击中目标前行驶1500公里。

sentences.en: When deaths go uncounted: WHO flags dangerous blind spots in Africa’s health data.
sentences.zh: 当死亡人数不计其数时：世卫组织在非洲的健康数据中标记危险的盲点。

sentences.en: Quality health data can help authorities to identify emerging threats and take lifesaving action, but a new report reveals critical gaps in Africa’s health information systems.
sentences.zh: 高质量的健康数据可以帮助当局识别新出现的威胁并采取挽救生命的行动，但一份新报告揭示了非洲卫生信息系统的关键差距。

items.title: Security Council LIVE: South Sudan’s first elections loom amid rising violence

sentences.zh: 安理会现场直播：南苏丹的首次选举迫在眉睫，暴力事件不断升级。

sentences.en: With South Sudan just six weeks away from its first national elections since independence, the Security Council meets in New York Tuesday amid deepening political uncertainty and worsening violence.
sentences.zh: 南苏丹距离独立以来的首次全国大选仅六周时间，安全理事会周二在纽约举行会议，政治不确定性加剧，暴力事件恶化。

sentences.en: Ambassadors are expected to press for an inclusive process and credible polls, while civilians bear the brunt of fighting, hunger and displacement.
sentences.zh: 预计大使们将推动包容性进程和可信的民意调查，而平民则首当其冲地承受着战斗、饥饿和流离失所的冲击。

sentences.zh: 在COP31的第二天，全球能源转型成为焦点，各国探索如何摆脱化石燃料，加速清洁能源，克服阻碍发展的金融和基础设施障碍。

sentences.en: Six journalists who make up the entire newsroom of the Egyptian fact-checking website Matsadash remain in detention, the UN human rights office (OHCHR) said on Tuesday, warning of proliferating assaults on press freedom by the Government.
sentences.zh: 联合国人权高专办（ OHCHR ）周二表示，构成埃及事实核查网站Matsadash整个新闻编辑室的六名记者仍被拘留，并警告政府对新闻自由的攻击激增。

items.title: Nearly 64,000 flee Nigeria for Niger where a humanitarian crisis is deepening

sentences.en: Nearly 64,000 flee Nigeria for Niger where a humanitarian crisis is deepening.
sentences.zh: 近64,000人逃离尼日利亚，前往尼日尔，那里的人道主义危机正在加深。

sentences.en: Violence in northern Nigeria is fueling a growing humanitarian crisis across the whole region: 64,000 have fled to neighbouring Niger and several hundred have left for Benin since the start of the year, as host countries struggle to cope, the UN’s refugee agency (UNHCR) said on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 联合国难民署周二表示，尼日利亚北部的暴力事件正在加剧整个地区日益严重的人道主义危机：自今年年初以来，已有64,000人逃往邻国尼日尔，数百人前往贝宁，因为东道国难以应对。

items.title: Ebola: IOM urges wider surveillance beyond formal routes in DR Congo

sentences.en: Seventy-one confirmed Ebola cases have been detected along transit routes in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) since the outbreak began almost six months ago, the International Organization for Migration (IOM) said on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 国际移民组织（ IOM ）周二表示，自近六个月前爆发疫情以来，在刚果民主共和国（ DRC ）的过境路线上已发现71例确诊埃博拉病例。

items.title: Trump says US war in Iran ‘effectively over’ as he plays down escalation concerns

sentences.en: Trump says US war in Iran ‘effectively over’ as he plays down escalation concerns.
sentences.zh: 特朗普表示，美国在伊朗的战争“实际上已经结束” ，因为他淡化了对局势升级的担忧。

sentences.en: President, after talks with Qatari PM, suggests end to war coming ‘fairly soon’ and military escalation not needed Donald Trump has said that the war in Iran is “effectively over” as he played down concerns that the US would escalate its military campaign against Tehran after the midterm elections.
sentences.zh: 总统在与卡塔尔总理会谈后表示，战争将“很快”结束，不需要军事升级，唐纳德·特朗普表示，伊朗战争“实际上已经结束” ，因为他淡化了人们对美国将在中期选举后升级对德黑兰的军事行动的担忧。

sentences.en: During a White House press conference, Trump said that Israel and Gulf allies in the region were well protected from Iran and that an escalation was not needed.
sentences.zh: 在白宫新闻发布会上，特朗普表示，该地区的以色列和海湾盟友受到伊朗的良好保护，不需要升级。

items.title: Witnesses recount struggle to save people buried in ‘horrifying’ Gaza landslide

sentences.en: Witnesses recount struggle to save people buried in ‘horrifying’ Gaza landslide.
sentences.zh: 目击者讲述了拯救被“可怕”的加沙山体滑坡掩埋的人们的斗争。

sentences.en: High winds and heavy rain triggered collapse of sand bank overlooking camp for displaced families Witnesses have described the frantic struggle to save three members of a family buried by a landslide triggered by high winds and heavy rain in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 大风和大雨引发了沙洲俯瞰流离失所家庭营地的倒塌。目击者描述了加沙大风和大雨引发的山体滑坡为拯救一个家庭的三名成员而进行的疯狂斗争。

sentences.en: A sand bank overlooking a camp for displaced families south of Deir al-Balah collapsed on Sunday, killing five people and crushing at least three tents.
sentences.zh: 俯瞰Deir al-Balah以南流离失所家庭营地的沙洲周日倒塌，造成5人死亡，至少3个帐篷被压碎。

items.title: AWS Weekly Roundup: AgentCore Runtime V2, Amazon DynamoDB bulk put items, and more (November 9, 2026)

sentences.en: AWS Weekly Roundup: AgentCore Runtime V2, Amazon DynamoDB bulk put items, and more (November 9, 2026).
sentences.zh: AWS每周综述： AgentCore Runtime V2、Amazon DynamoDB批量放置项目等（ 2026年11月9日）。

sentences.en: Most of the cost of adopting something new isn’t the new thing, it’s the move.
sentences.zh: 采用新事物的大部分成本不是新事物，而是移动。

sentences.en: Moving a Hive table to Apache Iceberg has typically meant weeks of engineering work.
sentences.zh: 将Hive表移到Apache Iceberg通常需要数周的工程工作。

sentences.en: Last week, Amazon S3 Tables turned that into three steps: start, sync as often as you need, complete.
sentences.zh: 上周， Amazon S3 Tables将其转化为三个步骤：启动、根据需要频繁同步、完成。

sentences.en: The source stays writable except for a few minutes at cutover.
sentences.zh: 除了在切换时几分钟外，源代码保持可写。

sentences.en: The same week, Amazon DynamoDB started loading data from S3 into tables that already exist.
sentences.zh: 同一周， Amazon DynamoDB开始将数据从S3加载到已存在的表中。

sentences.en: The pattern I like is that neither one asks you to stop what’s running.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢的模式是，没有人要求你停止正在运行的东西。

sentences.en: That’s also the way to read the agent news this week.
sentences.zh: 这也是阅读本周经纪人新闻的方式。

sentences.en: The new Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime is a single field on the runtime you already have, and Web Answer is a tool you attach to a gateway you already run.
sentences.zh: 新的Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime是已有运行时的单个字段， Web Answer是附加到已运行网关的工具。

sentences.en: Now, let’s get into this week’s AWS news… Headlines The new AgentCore Runtime: elastic, optimized, and consistently fast starts – If you run agents on AgentCore and haven’t tried the new runtime since it became generally available, it’s worth a look.
sentences.zh: 现在，让我们进入本周的AWS新闻… Headlines新的AgentCore运行时：弹性、优化和始终如一的快速启动–如果您在AgentCore上运行代理，并且自新运行时正式推出以来尚未尝试过，那么值得一看。

sentences.en: It changes two things.
sentences.zh: 它改变了两件事。

sentences.en: First, memory: sessions start small, page in more on demand, and give memory back when it goes cold instead of holding the peak, so you pay for what your agent uses.
sentences.zh: 首先，内存：会话从小规模开始，按需分页，并在冷却时恢复内存，而不是保持高峰，因此您需要为代理使用的内容付费。

items.title: Iran was behind cyber-attack on French supermarket freezers, Paris says

sentences.en: Iran was behind cyber-attack on French supermarket freezers, Paris says.
sentences.zh: 巴黎说，伊朗是法国超市冰柜网络攻击的幕后黑手。

sentences.en: French foreign minister vows European sanctions against Tehran over ‘unprecedented’ hacks last month France has said Iran was responsible for a massive cyber-attack on supermarket freezers and chiller cabinets that was described by its foreign minister as being an act of “unprecedented scale and unprecedented aggression”.
sentences.zh: 法国外交部长发誓要对德黑兰实施欧洲制裁，因为上个月发生了“前所未有的”黑客攻击。法国表示，伊朗应对超市冷冻柜和冷藏柜遭受的大规模网络攻击负责，法国外交部长称这是一次“前所未有的规模和前所未有的侵略”。

sentences.en: Jean-Noël Barrot said “Europe-wide sanctions” would be imposed against those responsible, adding that the attacks – which took control of digital thermostats to push temperatures up to above 50C – constituted “a major violation of the nation’s interests”.
sentences.zh: 让-诺埃尔·巴罗特（ Jean-Noël Barrot ）表示，将对责任人实施“全欧洲范围的制裁” ，并补充说，这些攻击–控制数字恒温器将温度推高至50摄氏度以上–构成“对国家利益的重大侵犯”。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: Do AI coding agents care about SemVer?

sentences.en: Do AI coding agents care about SemVer?.
sentences.zh: 人工智能编码代理是否关心SemVer ？。

sentences.en: Semantic versioning tells developers how risky an upgrade is.
sentences.zh: 语义版本控制告诉开发人员升级的风险有多大。

sentences.en: A patch fixes bugs, a minor release adds features without breaking anything and a major release breaks things, so you know how closely to look before you upgrade.
sentences.zh: 修补程序修复了错误，次要版本添加了功能而不会破坏任何东西，主要版本会破坏任何东西，因此在升级之前，您知道如何仔细查看。

sentences.en: On paper, that signal is redundant when an AI coding agent does the upgrade.
sentences.zh: 在纸面上，当AI编码代理进行升级时，该信号是冗余的。

sentences.en: The agent has no muscle memory tied to the old API.
sentences.zh: 客服代表没有与旧API绑定的肌肉记忆。

sentences.en: It can read the new code and run the tests, so why would it care what the version number says?
sentences.zh: 它可以读取新代码并运行测试，那么它为什么要关心版本号是什么？

sentences.en: We suspected it wouldn’t, and that SemVer had become something only people need.
sentences.zh: 我们怀疑它不会， SemVer已经成为人们需要的东西。

sentences.en: Two models proved us wrong.
sentences.zh: 两个模型证明我们错了。

sentences.en: Across two experiments and almost 1,000 runs, the version number alone changed what they did with byte-identical code.
sentences.zh: 在两次实验和近1000次运行中，仅版本号就改变了他们对字节相同代码的操作。

sentences.en: Given an upgrade that broke the app, Claude Sonnet 5.5 ran the tests or read the new code in 2 of 10 runs when the upgrade was labeled a patch, and in all 10 when it was labeled a major release.
sentences.zh: 鉴于升级破坏了应用程序，当升级被标记为补丁时， Claude Sonnet 5.5在10次运行中的2次运行测试或读取新代码，当它被标记为主要版本时，在所有10次运行中运行测试或读取新代码。

sentences.en: Other models checked every upgrade, whatever the label said.
sentences.zh: 其他型号检查了每次升级，无论标签说什么。

sentences.en: Some agents still read SemVer, and for them, a patch label is a reason to check less.
sentences.zh: 一些代理仍在阅读SemVer ，对他们来说，补丁标签是减少检查的理由。
